complaints.description: Class action lawsuits in 2024-2025 for defective moisture intrusion protection across multiple product lines
complaints.note: RED — active litigation with multiple plaintiffs documenting systematic defects

complaints.description: Consumer complaints of seal failures, fogged IGUs, and frame warping within 5 years of installation
complaints.note: YELLOW — pattern of complaints but individual consumer reports, not systematic testing

sources.name: Contractor assessment
sources.summary: Described as 'on par or better with most other manufacturers Professional windows' and 'balanced value/quality.' Mixed — adequate but not exceptional.

professional_consensus._note: Single Pool B source with mixed sentiment. Limited professional evaluation data available.

component_quality._note: Multi-chamber vinyl construction. Standard Intercept spacer system (aluminum-based). Argon gas fill, standard low-E glass.

repairability._note: Parts through Ply Gem dealer network. 10-year parts warranty, 2-year hardware coverage.

thermal.note: NFRC certified, Energy Star qualified. Multi-chamber vinyl frame. No specific DH U-Factor published.

structural.note: Manufacturer does not publish structural test data for DH configuration. Scored at certification floor for vinyl material class. Actual performance may be better.

air_water.note: Manufacturer does not publish air infiltration value for DH configuration. Energy Star / NFRC certified indicates minimum standards met. Scored at certification floor for vinyl material class. Actual performance may be significantly better.
